title: Several plugins for WordPress published by WP connect (Orders Sync to Airtable for WooCommerce, Add-On for Contact…
description: Several WordPress plugins published by WP connect contain a backdoor that loads on every request and periodically communicates with a remote command-and-control server. This backdoor sends site information and executes arbitrary PHP code returned by the server, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, manipulate files and databases, and maintain persistent access. The affected plugins have been removed from WordPress.org with no available patches. Users are strongly advised to uninstall these plugins and perform a full malware scan.
